create.title: Exact theta zero-row recombination and literal-BV cancellation
create.statement_tex: Fix A>0, J_A=M^(3/4)(log(2X))^A, K=sqrt(NM), and J_A<V<=K. In the literal D=d=L=1 ambient theta completion put q=4N, c=4N/d for every odd d|N, A_j=Bhat_j(0), and Z_U(V)=-i(1+i)/(2Nq) sum_(V<|j|<=2V) sum_(d|N,d odd) chi_4(d)d sqrt(c) A_j K(0,-j;c). On each signed block the actual zero-extended profile, exact residual phase, asymmetric cell, strict mask, and endpoints give sup|A_j|+Var(A_j)<<_epsilon K M^(-3/4)X^epsilon. If m=N/d=u^2r with r squarefree, epsilon_a(c/a) splits into the primitive Kronecker characters of the fundamental discriminants Delta_+=r or 4r and Delta_-=-r or -4r, with exact induced-modulus, Ramanujan, repeated-prime, conductor-one, and two-adic local factors. More directly, define S_N(j)=sum_(x mod 4N)1_(N|x^2-j)chi_4((x^2-j)/N). Exact quotient projection and the partition d=(h,N) give S_N(j)=-i(1+i)/(2N) sum_(d|N,d odd)chi_4(d)d sqrt(c)K(0,-j;c), hence Z_U(V)=(4N)^(-1)sum_j A_j S_N(j). Its finite Fourier transform vanishes at even h and has magnitude 2sqrt(8N(h,N)) at odd h, so every interval of length at most 4N has S_N-partial sum <<sqrt(N)tau(N)log(2N). Abel summation yields Z_U(V)<<_epsilon M^(-1/4)X^epsilon uniformly for arbitrary N, every d, both signs, all profile transitions, and all endpoints. An independent fixed-d proof uses sup_I|sum_(j in I)K(0,-j;c)|<<c log(2c) and gives the same power. This closes only v=0; the incomplete nonzero matrix remains open.

update.statement_tex: Fix A>0, J_A=M^(3/4)(log(2X))^A, K=sqrt(NM), and J_A<V<=K.
